name: sky-backdrop
title: Sky Backdrop
description: A calm daytime sky for a friendly hero: a soft gradient, a warm sun glow in one corner, and a few clouds drifting across. It suits pages that want warmth rather than drama, the light counterpart to `Starfield`.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/sky-backdrop

Installed to `components/ui/effects/sky-backdrop.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/sky-backdrop';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/sky-backdrop

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
